results.rationale: Neither CO-PROFILE nor any CAP record provides a stated bid validity commitment of 120 days, which is an administrative/mandatory compliance item.
There is no evidence in CO-PROFILE or CAP summaries confirming compliance with the two separate sealed-envelope submission requirement for technical and financial proposals.
No provided evidence confirms the required number of originals/copies for technical and financial proposals, which is a submission-format requirement.
No evidence states proposals will be addressed to the specified officer/department in Lahore, which is an administrative addressing requirement.
There is no evidence that our bid will explicitly respond to proposal sections Q1–Q7 as listed in the RFP; CAP records do not cover proposal-structure compliance.
